_readme: Where the News section's items come from. Run `npm run news` (it also runs before every `npm run build`) to rebuild news.json. `links`: any article or post about Arqus, as a URL, or as { url, title, source, author, date, summary, image } to fill in or override what the page says. `queries`: searched each run on Google News, Bing News, Bing and DuckDuckGo. `mustMention`: a result counts as about us if its text contains one of these (or 'Arqus' together with 'Meersman'). `exclude`: URL fragments never to keep. `hide`: exact URLs never to show.
